messages:
zoe (docs): PR #8459 swaps quota examples to the product term and adds Elixir + Rust snippets. Need a quick sanity check on header names, the dashboard anchor, and a tiny analytics query I added. https://confluence.redwood/internal/docs/usage-and-pricing
kevin (eng): Which header did you use? We agreed on x-rw-usage-plan last quarter but some internal samples still use x-rw-quota.
zoe (docs): Using x-rw-usage-plan in every snippet. Added one-line migration note: 'Legacy header x-rw-quota maps to x-rw-usage-plan.' Also updated the dashboard link to panel id=plan-summary-v5 (metric tokens_consumed_total).
syl (pm): UX prefers the term 'grace credits' in user-facing docs; internal teams can note 'burst' parenthetically. Please use "grace credits" in the main copy.
anya (analytics): For the dashboard reproducibility add this PromQL: sum(rate(tokens_consumed_total{plan=~"(free|pro|enterprise)"}[5m])) by (plan). Also include a BigQuery example for teams that export logs. I suggest:
SELECT plan, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM `analytics.usage` WHERE event_time BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() GROUP BY plan;
kevin (eng): Quick nit on the Elixir snippet: show Redwood.Client.new(timeout: 30_000) so examples don't hang. Also call out that grace credits are consumed before plan quota and do not refill mid-cycle (one short sentence).
zoe (docs): Adding the one-liner and switching Elixir snippet to include timeout. Draft Elixir + Rust snippets below for review:
Elixir:
```
client = Redwood.Client.new(api_key: System.get_env("TOKEN"), timeout: 30_000)
client |> Redwood.Client.put_header("x-rw-usage-plan", "enterprise")
IO.inspect(Redwood.Client.get(client, "/v1/usage"))
```
Rust (reqwest):
```
let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::builder().timeout(Duration::from_secs(30)).build()?;
let resp = client.get("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage").header("x-rw-usage-plan","pro").bearer_auth(&token).send()?;
println!("{}", resp.text()?);
```
doc-bot: docs-ci: lint started for PR #8459
anya (analytics): The BigQuery example looks fine. Maybe add a one-line note that exported logs use column name tokens and label plan for mapping.
kevin (eng): +1 from infra side; snippets look good after the timeout tweak.
doc-bot: docs-ci: lint passed \u2705
zoe (docs): Merged PR #8459, added migration note and PromQL, backfilled redirects for the old header anchors. Closing thread  thanks all!
